tables.note_tr: Kaynak: lavaan::cfa (estimator = 'ML', likelihood = 'wishart', std.lv = FALSE), lavaan::fitMeasures; lavaan 0.7.2. Olabilirlik Wishart (N − 1; AMOS/LISREL uyumlu). χ²/sd yalnızca bilgi içindir; eşik verilmez (SPEC_REVIEW W-4). Hu ve Bentler (1999) eşikleri ML ve sürekli veri için önerilmiştir; WLSMV'de CFI ve RMSEA farklı davranır (Xia ve Yang, 2019). Bu tabloda iyi/kötü sınıflaması yapılmaz.
tables.note_en: Source: lavaan::cfa (estimator = 'ML', likelihood = 'wishart', std.lv = FALSE), lavaan::fitMeasures; lavaan 0.7.2. Wishart likelihood (N − 1; AMOS/LISREL-compatible). χ²/df is for information only; no cut-off is applied (SPEC_REVIEW W-4). Hu and Bentler (1999) cut-offs were proposed for ML with continuous data; CFI and RMSEA behave differently under WLSMV (Xia & Yang, 2019). No good/poor classification is made in this table.

tables.note_tr: Kaynak: lavaan::parameterEstimates (standardized = TRUE). β: tam standardize çözüm (std.all). Her faktörün işaretleyici maddesinin yükü 1'e sabitlendi; bu maddelerin SH, z ve p değerleri yoktur.
tables.note_en: Source: lavaan::parameterEstimates (standardized = TRUE). β: completely standardized solution (std.all). The loading of each factor's marker item is fixed to 1; these items have no SE, z or p.

tables.note_tr: Kaynak: lavaan::modindices (sort. = TRUE). BPD: beklenen parametre değişimi. Kuramsal gerekçe olmadan parametre serbest bırakmak modeli örnekleme özgü hâle getirir, uyumu yapay olarak artırır ve sonucun başka örneklemlerde tekrarlanmasını zorlaştırır. Serbest bırakılan her parametre kuramsal olarak gerekçelendirilmeli ve raporda belirtilmelidir.
tables.note_en: Source: lavaan::modindices (sort. = TRUE). EPC: expected parameter change. Freeing parameters without theoretical justification capitalizes on chance, inflates fit artificially and makes replication less likely. Every freed parameter must be justified theoretically and reported.

olceklab_surumler <- c(lavaan = "0.7.2", digest = "0.6.39", psych = "2.6.9")
for (p in names(olceklab_surumler)) {
  v <- as.character(utils::packageVersion(p))
  if (v != olceklab_surumler[[p]]) warning(sprintf("%s sürümü farklı: %s (ÖlçekLab: %s). Sonuçlar farklı olabilir.", p, v, olceklab_surumler[[p]]))

## --- ÖlçekLab motorundan alınan veri okuma ve temizleme fonksiyonları (değiştirmeyin) ---
api_stop <- function (code, message_tr, status = 400L, detail = NULL) 
{
    cond <- structure(class = c("api_error", "error", "condition"), list(message = message_tr, call = NULL, 
        code = code, status = as.integer(status), detail = detail))
    stop(cond)
}

max_upload_bytes <- function () 
{
    as.numeric(Sys.getenv("MAX_UPLOAD_MB", "10")) * 1024^2
}

max_rows <- function () 
{
    as.integer(Sys.getenv("MAX_ROWS", "100000"))
}

parse_upload <- function (raw, filename) 
{
    if (!is.raw(raw) || length(raw) == 0L) 
        api_stop("empty_file", "Dosya boş.", 400L)
    if (length(raw) > max_upload_bytes()) {
        api_stop("file_too_large", sprintf("Dosya boyutu sınırı (%s MB) aşıldı.", format(max_upload_bytes()/1024^2)), 
            413L)
    }
    ext <- tolower(tools::file_ext(filename))
    df <- switch(ext, csv = , txt = , tsv = parse_delimited_bytes(raw), xlsx = , xls = parse_excel_bytes(raw, 
        ext), api_stop("unsupported_format", "Desteklenmeyen dosya biçimi. CSV ya da XLSX yükleyin.", 
        415L))
    validate_frame(df)
    list(data = df, hash = paste0("sha256:", digest::digest(raw, algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE)), 
        filename = basename(filename), delimiter = attr(df, "delimiter"))
}

parse_delimited_bytes <- function (raw) 
{
    if (length(raw) >= 3L && identical(raw[1:3], as.raw(c(239, 187, 191)))) 
        raw <- raw[-(1:3)]
    if (any(raw == as.raw(0))) {
        api_stop("not_utf8", "Dosya UTF-8 metin dosyası değil. Dosyayı UTF-8 CSV olarak kaydedip yeniden yükleyin.", 
            422L)
    }
    txt <- rawToChar(raw)
    Encoding(txt) <- "UTF-8"
    if (!validUTF8(txt)) {
        api_stop("not_utf8", "Dosya UTF-8 kodlamasında değil. Dosyayı UTF-8 CSV olarak kaydedip yeniden yükleyin.", 
            422L)
    }
    lines <- strsplit(txt, "\r\n|\n|\r")[[1]]
    lines <- lines[nzchar(trimws(lines))]
    if (length(lines) < 2L) 
        api_stop("no_rows", "Dosyada başlık satırından sonra veri yok.", 422L)
    header <- gsub("\"[^\"]*\"", "", lines[1])
    counts <- c(`;` = lengths(regmatches(header, gregexpr(";", header, fixed = TRUE))), `,` = lengths(regmatches(header, 
        gregexpr(",", header, fixed = TRUE))), `\t` = lengths(regmatches(header, gregexpr("\t", header, 
        fixed = TRUE))))
    if (max(counts) == 0L) 
        api_stop("delimiter_not_found", "Sütun ayracı bulunamadı (; , ya da sekme).", 422L)
    sep <- names(counts)[which.max(counts)]
    con <- textConnection(lines, encoding = "UTF-8")
    on.exit(close(con), add = TRUE)
    df <- tryCatch(utils::read.table(con, sep = sep, header = TRUE, quote = "\"", colClasses = "character", 
        check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA", "NaN"), strip.white = TRUE, comment.char = "", 
        encoding = "UTF-8", stringsAsFactors = FALSE), error = function(e) api_stop("parse_error", "Dosya okunamadı: satırlardaki sütun sayısı tutarsız olabilir.", 
        422L, conditionMessage(e)))
    names(df) <- trimws(names(df))
    df <- convert_columns(df, decimal_comma = sep != ",")
    attr(df, "delimiter") <- sep
    df
}

parse_excel_bytes <- function (raw, ext) 
{
    dir <- if (dir.exists("/dev/shm") && file.access("/dev/shm", 2L) == 0L) 
        "/dev/shm"
    else tempdir()
    path <- tempfile("olceklab-", tmpdir = dir, fileext = paste0(".", ext))
    on.exit(unlink(path, force = TRUE), add = TRUE)
    writeBin(raw, path)
    df <- tryCatch(readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = 1L, col_types = "text", .name_repair = "minimal"), 
        error = function(e) api_stop("parse_error", "Excel dosyası okunamadı.", 422L, conditionMessage(e)))
    df <- as.data.frame(df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
    names(df) <- trimws(names(df))
    df <- convert_columns(df, decimal_comma = TRUE)
    attr(df, "delimiter") <- NA_character_
    df
}

convert_columns <- function (df, decimal_comma) 
{
    for (j in seq_along(df)) {
        v <- trimws(as.character(df[[j]]))
        v[v %in% c("", "NA", "NaN")] <- NA_character_
        cand <- if (decimal_comma) 
            gsub(",", ".", v, fixed = TRUE)
        else v
        num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cand))
        df[[j]] <- if (all(is.na(v) == is.na(num))) 
            num
        else v
    }
    df
}

validate_frame <- function (df) 
{
    nm <- names(df)
    if (ncol(df) == 0L || nrow(df) == 0L) 
        api_stop("no_rows", "Dosyada veri yok.", 422L)
    if (any(is.na(nm) | !nzchar(trimws(nm)))) 
        api_stop("blank_column_name", "Adı boş olan sütun var.", 422L)
    if (anyDuplicated(nm)) {
        api_stop("duplicate_column_name", sprintf("Aynı adı taşıyan sütunlar var: %s", paste(unique(nm[duplicated(nm)]), 
            collapse = ", ")), 422L)
    }
    if (nrow(df) > max_rows()) 
        api_stop("too_many_rows", sprintf("Satır sınırı (%d) aşıldı.", max_rows()), 413L)
    invisible(TRUE)
}

example_csv_hash <- function (df) 
{
    txt <- paste(utils::capture.output(utils::write.csv(df, row.names = FALSE)), collapse = "\n")
    paste0("sha256:", digest::digest(charToRaw(enc2utf8(txt)), algo = "sha256", serialize = FALSE))
}

load_example <- function (name) 
{
    if (identical(name, "holzinger")) {
        df <- lavaan::HolzingerSwineford1939
        df$school <- as.character(df$school)
        items <- paste0("x", 1:9)
        roles <- stats::setNames(rep("ignore", ncol(df)), names(df))
        roles[items] <- "item"
        roles["id"] <- "id"
        roles["school"] <- "group"
        cfg <- list(roles = as.list(roles), items = lapply(stats::setNames(items, items), function(i) list(reverse = FALSE, 
            subscale = c("visual", "textual", "speed")[(as.integer(sub("x", "", i)) - 1L)%/%3L + 1L])))
        source <- sprintf("lavaan %s: HolzingerSwineford1939", as.character(utils::packageVersion("lavaan")))
    }
    else if (identical(name, "bfi")) {
        df <- psych::bfi
        rownames(df) <- NULL
        items <- names(df)[1:25]
        reverse <- c("A1", "C4", "C5", "E1", "E2", "O2", "O5")
        roles <- stats::setNames(rep("ignore", ncol(df)), names(df))
        roles[items] <- "item"
        roles["gender"] <- "group"
        cfg <- list(roles = as.list(roles), items = lapply(stats::setNames(items, items), function(i) list(min = 1, 
            max = 6, reverse = i %in% reverse, subscale = substr(i, 1, 1))))
        source <- sprintf("psych %s: bfi", as.character(utils::packageVersion("psych")))
    }
    else {
        api_stop("example_not_found", "Örnek veri seti bulunamadı (holzinger ya da bfi).", 404L)
    }
    list(data = df, hash = example_csv_hash(df), filename = paste0(name, ".csv"), source = source, suggested_config = cfg)
}

clean_dataset <- function (data, config, rules = list()) 
{
    on <- function(key) if (is.null(rules[[key]])) 
        TRUE
    else isTRUE(rules[[key]])
    items <- config$items$name
    grp <- config$group
    x <- data
    n_raw <- nrow(x)
    keep <- rep(TRUE, n_raw)
    steps <- data.frame(step = character(), removed = integer(), remaining = integer(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    add_step <- function(step, bad) {
        newly <- bad & keep
        keep <<- keep & !newly
        steps[nrow(steps) + 1L, ] <<- list(step, sum(newly), sum(keep))
    }
    item_missing <- vapply(items, function(i) mean(is.na(x[[i]])), numeric(1))
    if (!is.null(grp) && on("invalid_group")) {
        g <- x[[grp]]
        bad <- is.na(g)
        if (length(config$group_valid_values)) 
            bad <- bad | !(as.character(g) %in% config$group_valid_values)
        add_step("invalid_group", bad)
    }
    if (on("missing")) {
        add_step("missing", !stats::complete.cases(x[, items, drop = FALSE]))
    }
    bounded <- items[!is.na(config$items$min)]
    if (length(bounded) && on("out_of_range")) {
        bad <- rep(FALSE, n_raw)
        for (i in bounded) {
            v <- x[[i]]
            lo <- config$items$min[config$items$name == i]
            hi <- config$items$max[config$items$name == i]
            bad <- bad | (!is.na(v) & (v < lo | v > hi | v != round(v)))
        }
        add_step("out_of_range", bad)
    }
    if (on("straightline")) {
        m <- as.matrix(x[, items, drop = FALSE])
        bad <- apply(m, 1L, function(r) {
            r <- r[!is.na(r)]
            length(r) >= 2L && all(r == r[1])
        })
        add_step("straightline", bad)
    }
    out <- x[keep, c(items, grp), drop = FALSE]
    rownames(out) <- NULL
    reversed <- character()
    if (on("reverse")) {
        for (k in which(config$items$reverse)) {
            i <- config$items$name[k]
            out[[i]] <- config$items$min[k] + config$items$max[k] - out[[i]]
            reversed <- c(reversed, i)
        }
    }
    list(data = out, steps = steps, n_raw = n_raw, n_final = nrow(out), item_missing = item_missing, 
        reversed = reversed)
}

## --- 1. Veri ---
kaynak <- load_example("holzinger")
ham <- kaynak$data
stopifnot(identical(kaynak$hash, "sha256:21cf08c770d8ceec61548a575a29477025ea14ffc60fd6fd3359c12afdcd477f"))

## --- 2. Temizleme (ÖlçekLab ayarlarıyla) ---
config <- list(items = structure(list(name = c("x1", "x2", "x3", "x4", "x5", "x6", "x7", "x8", "x9"), min = c(NA_real_, 
NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_), max = c(NA_real_, NA_real_, 
NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_), reverse = c(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, 
FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE, FALSE), subscale = c("visual", "visual", "visual", "textual", "textual", 
"textual", "speed", "speed", "speed")), row.names = c(NA, -9L), class = "data.frame"), group = "school", 
    group_valid_values = NULL, id_columns = structure("id", class = "AsIs"))
rules <- list()
temiz <- clean_dataset(ham, config, rules)$data

## --- 3. Analiz ---
items <- c("x1", "x2", "x3", "x4", "x5", "x6", "x7", "x8", "x9")
x <- temiz[, items, drop = FALSE]
model <- "visual =~ x1 + x2 + x3\ntextual =~ x4 + x5 + x6\nspeed =~ x7 + x8 + x9"
options(mc.cores = 1)
RNGkind("Mersenne-Twister", "Inversion", "Rejection")
set.seed(20261030L)
fit <- lavaan::cfa(model, data = x, estimator = "ML", likelihood = "wishart", std.lv = FALSE, test = "bollen.stine", bootstrap = 100L, iseed = 20261030L, parallel = "no")
pe <- lavaan::parameterEstimates(fit, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)
sonuc <- list(fit = lavaan::fitMeasures(fit), loadings = pe[pe$op == "=~", ],
              post_check = lavaan::lavInspect(fit, "post.check"),
              mi = lavaan::modindices(fit, sort. = TRUE, maximum.number = 10L),
              bollen_stine = lavaan::lavInspect(fit, "test")$bollen.stine)
print(sonuc)
